headline: SIX VERY DIFFERENT REASONS TO EXPLORE
dek: Dunes, wildlife and the Atlantic coast
caption:
What would a road trip across Namibia actually look like? 🌍

One day you're dwarfed by the granite formations at Spitzkoppe. Another you're walking between enormous red dunes, then standing on the surreal white clay pan of Deadvlei. On the Atlantic coast, the desert meets the ocean — and further inland, Etosha offers a very different kind of adventure.

These six scenes aren't one short route: Namibia's distances are substantial. Think of them as the ingredients for a longer journey, and build in time for the places you most want to experience.

If wildlife, otherworldly landscapes and wide-open roads are your thing, save Namibia to your travel ideas. 🗺️

Photography: NIR HIMI, Andrew Svk, David Lartey & Patrick Duvanel / Unsplash.
